role: Speculative enquiry: graduate / junior civil site role
cover_letter_text:
Hi Quantum Civil team,

I'm Marc, and I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. I'd like to start out in a graduate or junior civil site role. This isn't for an advertised job, but your careers page welcomes people who are just starting out, so I wanted to ask if you have anything.

I also have a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and I worked on site there until February 2020 as project-in-charge and then field engineer. That meant inspections, quality checks and writing site reports. These days I work casual shifts at a bp service station in Melbourne.

I live in Melton with my own transport and have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). I can start two weeks after an offer. If anything comes up, I'd be glad to hear from you.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
